summary: Free desktop app that enlarges and sharpens low-resolution images with AI, on Windows, macOS and Linux.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Upscayl is a free, open-source desktop app that uses AI to enlarge and enhance low-resolution images. You open a picture, choose a model and scale, and it produces a bigger, sharper version on your own computer.
sixtySeconds.problem: Enlarging a small image normally makes it blurry. Upscayl uses AI upscaling models to add detail instead, without uploading your photos to an online service.
whoFor: People restoring old or small photos
Anyone who wants offline image upscaling
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a simple, free desktop upscaler that runs locally on Windows, macOS and Linux.
requirements: A Vulkan-compatible GPU (many integrated GPUs don't work)

overview: Download the app for your system from the releases page or upscayl.org. Linux users can use the AppImage, Flatpak, Snap, RPM, DEB or ZIP; macOS users get a DMG or can use Homebrew; Windows users run the installer.
Upscaling runs on your GPU through Vulkan, so a compatible graphics card is required; the README notes that many integrated GPUs don't work.
limitations: Windows installer may show a SmartScreen warning

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Upscayl's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Download the mac .dmg
steps.body: From the latest GitHub release or upscayl.org.

steps.title: Install
steps.body: Drag Upscayl into Applications, then right-click it and choose Open the first time.

steps.title: Download the win .exe
steps.body: From the latest GitHub release or upscayl.org.

steps.title: Run it
steps.body: If SmartScreen warns you, click More Info, then Run Anyway, and follow the installer.

steps.title: Download the linux .AppImage
steps.body: From the latest GitHub release or upscayl.org.

steps.title: Make it executable and run
steps.body: In the file's Permissions tab, allow executing, then double-click it. RPM, DEB, ZIP, Flatpak and Snap are also available.

firstRun.title: Upscale an image
firstRun.body: Open Upscayl, select an image, pick a model and output folder, then start upscaling.

tutorial.title: Enlarge a small photo
tutorial.useCase: Use Upscayl to make a low-resolution photo bigger and sharper.

steps.title: Open Upscayl and select your image
Choose a model and output folder
Click upscale and wait for it to finish

tutorial.expected: An enlarged, sharper copy of your image is saved in the output folder.
